notes: Public search, metadata, and sample previews require no credentials.
Full dataset retrieval, including free datasets, purchases, private history, and writes require a DataBazaar account.
For authenticated tools, use https://api.databazaar.io/mcp or run npx -y databazaar-mcp auth login before starting the local stdio server. An account API key is also supported.
Maintainer-provided metadata. The hosted public endpoint exposes three discovery tools; the local package also exposes account tools that require authorization when called.
MIT covers the MCP server code; individual datasets have their own licenses.
